thread:
deploy-bot: Alert: canary pool 'redwood-canary-eu' error rate spike > 6% for /v1/generate over 3m. Paging oncall @miguel

miguel: oncall here, ACKing. seeing high 502s in the canary. pulling logs now

jamie: grabbing node logs and proxy traces, looks like tokenization errors + long tails, some requests hitting 10s latency

alice: is this the quantized variant we rolled out this morning?

miguel: yes, canary was pushed at 04:12UTC, ~8% traffic. automated rollback didn't trigger, threshold check returned 0 (bug?)

ops-bot: Automated rollback attempt failed: rate_limit_check returned malformed metric key (error_id=ops_64321). Investigating.

jamie: quick check: the canary instances are returning this in logs:
```
runtime_error: tokenizer mismatch: unknown bytes at offset 128
trace: tokenization failed, fallback to CPU path, kv cache invalidated
```

karen: customer impact: support reports ~7 customers saw request timeouts in the EU region, two had production traffic. No data exfiltration.

lisa: I've opened ticket INC-1029 for affected customers and started outreach to the two big ones. prepping status blurb

miguel: immediate plan: 1) pause rollout and throttle canary traffic to 0% 2) force manual rollback to model v3.2-ptq-compat 3) verify smoke requests and slo metrics 4) follow-up postmortem.

alice: how do we pause rollout? feature flag or route weight?

jamie: we can flip the rollout flag, but router override is faster. running: `infractl route update redwood-canary-eu --weight 0`

miguel: executing now. `infractl route update redwood-canary-eu --weight 0` -> response: OK. traffic drained to 0% (confirming TCP connections draining).

deploy-bot: Manual rollback initiated by @miguel: rolling to model v3.2-ptq-compat (tag: stable-2026-03-17).

jamie: rollback in progress, steps: stop canary pods, start stable pods, warm KV caches. ETA ~3m for warmup.

ops-bot: Watcher: new stable instances passed healthcheck. 3/3 ready.

miguel: running smoke tests against /v1/generate (short and long prompts). sample commands:
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"Tell me a joke"}' https://api.eu.redwood.ai/v1/generate
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"Summarize 2000 tokens of legal doc"}' https://api.eu.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

jamie: smoke looks good, latency back to normal (~120ms p50, p95 400ms) and error rate down to baseline.

miguel: verifying customer-facing errors dropped. lisa, can you confirm support tickets trend?

lisa: tickets moving to resolved, initial customers notified. sending updated status now.

karen: do we need to block the quantized variant from future rollouts until tokenization fix?

jamie: yes. we'll add a rollout gate: require tokenizer integration tests + canary-only tokenization metric before traffic >0%. Also add post-deploy smoke with long-context prompts.

miguel: filing immediate remediation: 1) patch metric name bug causing failed auto-rollback 2) revert canary image in registry 3) add tokenization test in CI 4) postmortem scheduled. Assigning owners: jamie (metrics + CI), alice (registry revert + release process), miguel (postmortem lead), lisa (customer comms).

deploy-bot: Incident paged cleared by @miguel. Status: mitigated, rollback complete, partial customer impact (time-limited timeouts), no data loss.

miguel: thanks all. keeping thread open for postmortem notes. please drop any additional observations below. :thumbsup:

jamie: noted we saw KV cache thrashing during CPU fallback; adding instrumentation to detect fallback counts.

alice: will freeze canary image until postmortem done.

lisa: awaiting customer replies, will escalate if any further impact reported.

ops-bot: Auto-assigning postmortem doc INC-1029 -> owners: miguel,jamie,alice.

miguel: closing thread in 1h if no new issues. thanks again.
